title: ReviseRequest
description: A reviewer's free-form note about a rendered cut. The note is prose on purpose (REQ-112) — turning it into structured constraints IS the skill.

jobId.description: Becomes a directory name under `project-data/jobs/`. The pattern is defence in depth — `jobDir()` in @cutdown/skill-runtime guards and containment-checks it regardless of caller, because a skill's `entrypoint` is a documented direct invocation.

renderId.description: The render the note is about. The EDL to revise is read from it, so a note can never be applied to a cut the reviewer did not watch. Must be a ULID: it becomes a FILENAME under the job (and, for outputs, a directory that is created on the way), so a traversing value would read or write inside another job. The skill asserts it again before joining, because a skill's `entrypoint` is a documented direct invocation and a schema-only guard has the same bypass shape the Phase 2 HIGH had.

notes.description: The reviewer's words, verbatim. Every emitted constraint's `sourceText` must be a substring of this, which is what makes the interpretation checkable.

recordedModelPath.description: Test/fixture only: a recorded interpretation replayed over an injected transport (tech-spec §6.6 constrained fixtures).
